plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked blood-sugar and islet chart shows the pancreas's two cell types — 98% digestive acinar cells (secreting trypsin that destroys insulin) vs 1%–2% Islets of Langerhans (discovered in 1869, secreting insulin) — alongside Leonard Thompson's blood glucose dropping from 520 mg/dL (5.2× normal) to 120 mg/dL within 24 hours of James Collip's purified insulin injection on 23 January 1922.
